message: I remember a dinner party when my friend Sarah overcooked the pasta, and the smoke alarm decided to join the fun. While we were all waving towels and laughing, she was convinced we were seconds away from a full-blown fire. I had to remind her that smoke alarms are just doing their job, but it got me thinking about how important it is to have a calm escape plan. It’s all about being prepared, so we can focus on enjoying our time together instead of panicking. Do you have a fire safety plan with your friends or family?
